With the Takarazuka Kinen looming, Narita 
Top Road has yet to reach T.M. Opera O.
To 
break through the current impasse, she 
visits her mentor once more.

Their mentor likened T.M. Opera O's 
strength to that of a European soccer 
player.
A one-track approach won't stand a 
chance against her—

Broadening her horizons—together with 
Narita Top Road, she feverishly read 
through soccer history books and realized 
the value of a friend who pushes her 
higher.

Admire Vega was waiting on the track.
Even 
on a path she couldn't walk alone, if she 
had friends to hone her running
alongside, she could forge ahead...!

Watched over even by the fans who
gathered 
late into the night... Narita Top Road 
pressed forward, guided by the starlight!
